title: RPP: A Certified Poisoned-Sample Detection Framework for Backdoor Attacks under Dataset Imbalance
abstract: arXiv:2602.00183v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deep neural networks are highly susceptible to backdoor attacks, yet most defense methods to date rely on balanced data, overlooking the pervasive class imbalance in real-world scenarios that can amplify backdoor threats. This paper presents the first in-depth investigation of how the dataset imbalance amplifies backdoor vulnerability, showing that (i) the imbalance induces a majority-class bias that increases susceptibility and (ii) conventional defenses degrade significantly as the imbalance grows. To address this, we propose Randomized Probability Perturbation (RPP), a certified poisoned-sample detection framework that operates in a black-box setting using only model output probabilities. For any inspected sample, RPP determines whether the input has been backdoor-manipulated, while offering provable within-domain detectability guarantees and a probabilistic upper bound on the false positive rate. translated_title: RPP：面向数据集不平衡场景下后门攻击的认证型中毒样本检测框架
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络极易受到后门攻击，然而迄今为止大多数防御方法都依赖于平衡数据，忽视了现实场景中普遍存在的类别不平衡问题，而这种不平衡会进一步放大后门威胁。本文首次深入研究了数据集不平衡如何放大后门攻击的脆弱性，研究结果表明：（i）不平衡会引起多数类偏差，从而增加模型对后门攻击的易感性；（ii）随着不平衡程度的加剧，传统防御方法的性能会显著下降。为解决这一问题，我们提出了随机化概率扰动，这是一种认证型中毒样本检测框架，可在黑盒设置下仅利用模型输出概率进行操作。对于任意被检测的样本，RPP能够判断该输入是否遭受了后门操纵，同时提供可证明的域内可检测性保证以及误报率的概率上界。在……上进行了大量实验（原文此处截断）
tldr: 本文首次揭示了数据集不平衡会加剧后门攻击的脆弱性，并提出了一种仅在黑盒设置下利用模型输出概率运行的认证型中毒样本检测框架RPP，该框架可提供可证明的域内可检测性保证和误报率的概率上界。
